blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Mitotic figure (MF) analysis supports tumor grading and prognostic assessment, but automated models remain sensitive to differences in tissue type and image acquisition. We present MiTHras, a task-specific pretraining framework that combines pseudo-label-guided image- and token-level contrastive learning with masked reconstruction. We construct TCGA-MF-Pseudo, a corpus of 1.8 million cell-centered images from 14 TCGA cohorts spanning 11 organ sites. Comprehensive evaluation on MF classification, detection, count-based survival prediction, and subtype classification demonstrates the efficacy of MiTHras. It achieves the highest mean F 1 on all three MF classification benchmarks and both subtype benchmarks. MiTHras also outperforms general-purpose and pathology foundation encoders by a larger margin under frozen-encoder linear probing than under full fine-tuning. Although detection gains are modest due to a shared candidate-detection stage, ablations confirm that token-level supervision improves typical-versus-atypical classification and linear probing. These findings establish that MiTHras yields robust, transferable representations for automated mitotic activity assessment.
blocks.zh: 光子图(MF)分析支持肿瘤分级和预测性评估,但自动化模型对组织类型和图像获取的差异仍然敏感. 我们提出MITHras,一个任务特定的预训框架,将伪标签制导的图像和符号级别的对比性学习与被蒙住的重建相结合. 我们建造了TCGA-MF-Pseudo, 由来自TCGA14个组群的180万个以细胞为中心的图像组成, 覆盖了11个器官地点。 对MF分类,检测,计数生存预测和亚类分类的综合评价证明了MITHras的功效. 它在所有三个MF分类基准和两个子类型基准中都实现了最高的平均值F 1. MiTHras在冷冻-编码器线性探测下比在全微调下比一般目的和病理基础编码器的功率要大。 虽然由于共同的候选检测阶段,检测增益不大,但分解证实,象征级监督改进了典型-非典型分类和线性检测. 这些调查结果确定,MITHras为自动线粒体活性评估提供了强有力的、可转移的表述。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: The mitotic count is a marker of cell proliferation used in cancer diagnosis, tumor grading, and prognostic assessment [ 1 ] . Pathologists determine it by counting mitotic figures (MFs) within a specified tissue area, following tumor-specific grading protocols [ 2 , 3 ] . It is a core component of the Nottingham grading system for invasive breast carcinoma [ 4 ] and FNCLCC grading in soft-tissue sarcoma [ 5 ] , drives risk stratification in gastrointestinal stromal tumors [ 6 ] , and defines tumor grade together with Ki-67 in gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors [ 7 ] . Automated MF analysis provides a total count with precise locations, allowing pathologists to inspect the underlying detections. These outputs complement weakly supervised models that predict slide-level clinical endpoints. We consider two metrics for mitotic activity. The mitotic hotspot count reports the highest MF count within a fixed area. The mitotic density denotes the total MF count per unit tissue area. A localized active focus can therefore produce a high hotspot count but a low overall density.
blocks.zh: 线粒体计数是细胞扩散的标志,用于癌症诊断,肿瘤分级,以及预测性评估[1]. 病理学家通过按照肿瘤特定分级协议计算特定组织区域内的线粒体数字[2,3]来确定. 它是诺丁汉入侵性乳腺癌分级系统[4]和FNCLCC分级为软质组织 sarcoma [5]的核心组成部分,驱动胃肠分泌瘤的风险分级[6],并在胃肠道分泌神经分泌瘤中与Ki-67一起定义了肿瘤分级[7]. 自动化MF分析提供了包含精确位置的总计数,使病理学家能够检查基础检测. 这些产出补充了对滑行水平临床终点进行预测的弱监督模型. 我们考虑两个度量衡的线粒体活性。 线粒体热点计数报告一个固定区域内MF计数最高. 线粒体密度表示每个单位组织区域的总MF计数. 因此,局部活动焦点可以产生高热点数,但总体密度较低。

blocks.en:
With the increasing availability of digitized whole-slide images (WSIs), a growing number of datasets have been developed for mitotic figure detection across diverse cancers and organs [ 8 ] . However, these datasets remain limited in size and diversity due to the high cost of annotation, restricting their ability to support large-scale model training. Consequently, domain shift remains a major challenge, leading to degraded performance when models are applied to unseen cancer types or data sources [ 9 ] .
In computational pathology, pretraining plays a key role in improving model generalization under limited annotations. Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as an effective strategy by leveraging large-scale unlabeled histopathology data, through contrastive learning (e.g. SimCLR [ 10 ] ), self-distillation, and masked image modeling (MIM) (e.g. MAE [ 11 ] ). These methods have been adapted to pathology to train general-purpose feature extractors such as CTransPath-MoCov3 [ 12 ] and Virchow [ 13 ] . While these models generalize strongly across tasks, they are designed as generic feature extractors rather than optimized for a specific task such as MF analysis.
blocks.zh:
随着数字化全滑图象的日益普及,开发了越来越多的数据集,用于对各种癌症和器官进行相位图检测[8]。 然而,由于注释成本高,这些数据集的规模和多样性仍然有限,限制了它们支持大规模模型培训的能力. 因此,域位转移仍然是一个重大挑战,如果模型被应用于看不见的癌症类型或数据来源,则导致性能退化[9]。
在计算病理学中,预训在有限说明下改进模型通论方面发挥关键作用. 自我监督的学习(SSL)通过利用大规模无标签的病理学数据,通过对比性学习(如SimCLR [10]),自沉,和蒙面图像模型制作(MIM)(如MAE [11])而成为一种有效的策略. 这些方法被调整为病理学,以训练CTransPath-MoCov3 [12]和Virchow [13]等通用特征提取器. 虽然这些模型在任务中被强烈地概括,但它们被设计为通用特征提取器,而不是为MF分析等特定任务而优化.

blocks.en:
Most pretrained models are used as frozen feature extractors with task-specific heads for downstream applications such as WSI classification and survival prediction [ 13 , 14 ] . Further adaptation can improve performance [ 15 , 16 ] , for example through knowledge distillation [ 17 ] . However, discrepancies between pretraining objectives and downstream tasks introduce a domain gap that limits direct transfer.
Moreover, most pretrained (foundation) models are trained on relatively large image patches (e.g., 112 × \times 112 μ ​ m \mu m ), whereas MFs are typically assessed at much finer scales (e.g., 32 × \times 32 μ ​ m \mu m ) [ 18 ] . This mismatch in resolution and context limits their effectiveness, as does the presence of numerous visually similar mimickers such as apoptotic cells and lymphocytes, which calls for task-specific rather than generic features. Recent pathology foundation models generalize well, but their size makes them expensive for dense inference tasks such as mitotic detection. With limited and imbalanced datasets, these challenges motivate efficient, task-specific pretraining.
blocks.zh:
多数被预先训练的模型被作为有特定任务头的冷冻特征提取器,用于下游应用,例如WSI分类和生存预测[13,14]. 进一步的适应可以提高性能[15,16],例如通过知识分馏[17]。 然而,培训前目标和下游任务之间的差异造成了域间差距,限制了直接转让。
此外,大多数被预先训练(建立)的模型都接受了相对较大的图像补丁(如:112 × \times 112 μ m \mu m)的培训,而MF通常以更细的尺度评估(如:32 × \times 32 μ m \mu m) [18]. 这种在分辨率和上下文上的不匹配限制了其有效性,许多视觉相近的缩影,如口腔细胞和淋巴细胞的存在也限制了其有效性,这需要针对特定任务而非通用特征. 最近的病理基础模型一般化得很好,但是它们的大小使得它们对于密密的推论任务,如线粒体检测来说,代价高昂. 由于数据集有限且不平衡,这些挑战促使开展高效的、针对具体任务的预先培训。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose MiTHras, a Mi totic figure analysis model based on T ask-specific H ierarchical semi-supervised cont ras tive learning with a masked autoencoder.
Through a single, unified objective, it integrates image-label contrast, which aligns the representations of crops that share a mitotic or mimicker pseudo-label, token-level contrast, which aligns local features using pseudo bounding boxes, and masked reconstruction that preserves image information. We evaluate MiTHras on MF classification, detection, count-based survival prediction, and subtype classification.

blocks.en: II Related work
blocks.zh: 二. 有关工作

blocks.en: II-A Mitotic figure detection
blocks.zh: II-A 测出自流图

blocks.en:
Deep learning approaches for MF analysis include classification, object detection, segmentation, and two-stage pipelines. Methods often incorporate domain adaptation to address domain shift caused by variations in scanners, staining, and tissue types.
Object detection-based methods have shown effectiveness in localizing MFs; [ 19 ] , for instance, introduced a domain-adversarial RetinaNet to reduce domain shift. Segmentation-based methods instead leverage pixel-level predictions to capture fine-grained mitotic features: MaskMitosis [ 20 ] adopts Mask R-CNN with a ResNet-FPN backbone [ 21 ] , and other works combine segmentation with Mask R-CNN for detection [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh:
MF分析的深层学习方法包括分类,物体检测,分化,和两级管线等. 方法往往包括域调整,以解决扫描仪、污渍和组织类型变化引起的域转移。
基于对象检测的方法在将MF本地化方面显示出了效果;例如,[19]引入了域-对抗的RetinaNet来减少域位转移. 基于分解的方法相反利用像素水平的预测来捕捉精细的线粒体特征: 蒙上米托西斯 [20] 收养 Mask R-CNN并配有ResNet-FPN主干线[21],而其他作品将分化与Mask R-CNN结合进行检测[22].

blocks.en: Two-stage models typically detect candidate regions and subsequently classify them. FoCasNet [ 23 ] used a feature pyramid network for detection and a ResNet [ 21 ] for classification, and [ 22 ] combined Mask R-CNN for segmentation with an ensemble of DenseNet and ResNet. MDFS [ 18 ] adopted Efficient-UNet-b0 for segmentation and EfficientNet for classification, achieving top performance in both MIDOG21 [ 8 ] and MIDOG22 [ 9 ] challenges. More recently, vision-language models have been applied to MF analysis: [ 24 ] paired MF images with descriptive captions to support captioning and visual question answering, and by integrating modality and scanner information demonstrated improved cross-domain adaptability.
blocks.zh: 两级模型通常检测候选区域,然后将其分类。 FoCasNet [23] 使用特征金字塔网络进行检测,并使用ResNet [21]进行分类,[22] 将Mask R-CNN与DenseNet和ResNet的组合分化. MDFS [18] 采用高效-UNet-b0进行分门别类,并采用高效网络进行分类,在MIDOG21[8]和MIDOG22[9]挑战中都取得了最佳业绩。 最近,在MF分析中采用了视觉语言模型:[24]对MF图像进行配对,并配有描述性说明,以支持字幕和视觉问题回答,同时将模式和扫描仪信息结合起来,显示跨领域适应性得到提高。

blocks.en: Despite these advancements, most existing methods heavily rely on supervised data across multiple domains and require domain alignment strategies. In this work, we propose a pretrained framework designed to learn from diverse cancer types and scanner sources, aiming to enhance the generalization ability in MF detection.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进步,但大多数现有方法都严重依赖多个领域的监督数据,需要域域协调战略。 在这项工作中,我们提出了一个经过预先培训的框架,旨在从各种癌症类型和扫描仪来源中学习,目的是提高MF检测的普及能力。

blocks.en: II-B Representation learning in computational pathology
blocks.zh: II-B 计算病理学中的代表性学习

blocks.en: Hierarchical pathology models combine information across spatial scales. HIPT [ 25 ] stacks self-supervised transformers from patch to region to slide, CTransPath [ 12 ] captures multiscale features via windowed attention. Attention-based multiple-instance learning aggregates patch features for slide-level prediction [ 26 ] . While these approaches capture broad tissue context, MiTHras focuses on representations within cell-centered patches, combining image-level class information with local token labels. Pretraining methods also differ in how they incorporate supervision. General-purpose encoders learn broadly transferable features, whereas supervised approaches like SupMAE [ 27 ] incorporate class labels during pretraining. MiTHras bridges these approaches, providing task-specific supervision at both image and token levels over a large, unannotated corpus.
blocks.zh: 分级病理模型将跨空间尺度的信息相融合. HIPT [25] 堆放自控变压器从补丁到区域到滑行, CTransPath [12] 通过窗口的注意来捕捉多级特性. 基于注意力的多层学习聚合物补丁功能,用于幻灯片级预测 [26]. 虽然这些方法能捕捉到广泛的组织上下文,MITHras则注重细胞中心补丁内的表达,将图像级类信息与当地的活标标签结合. 预先培训方法在如何纳入监督方面也有所不同。 通用编码器学习可广泛转让的特性,而SupMAE[27]等监督方法则在预训期间包含类标签。 MiTHras将这些方法相接而来,在形象和象征层面提供针对具体任务的监督,监督一个大型的、无附加说明的文书。

blocks.en: II-C Masked autoencoders
blocks.zh: II-C 面罩自动编码器

blocks.en: The core idea of MAEs is to learn robust representations by reconstructing images from masked or partially observed patches. Inspired by masked language modeling in BERT [ 28 ] and by vision transformers (ViTs) [ 29 ] , MIM [ 11 , 30 ] has gained attention as a generative SSL approach. MAE reconstructs raw pixels through an asymmetric encoder-decoder [ 11 ] , and DiffMAE [ 30 ] extends this with iterative diffusion processes.
blocks.zh: MAEs的核心思想是通过从被蒙蔽或部分被观测到的补丁上重建图像来学习强势的表示. 受BERT [28] 和视觉变压器 (ViTs) [29] 的蒙面语言模型的启发,MIM [11,30] 作为一种基因化的SSL方法获得了关注. MAE通过非对称编码器-解码器来重建生像素[11],而DiffMAE[30]则用迭代扩散过程来扩展这个.

blocks.en: II-D Supervised contrastive learning
blocks.zh: II-D 监督的对比性学习

blocks.en: Contrastive learning typically models the similarity and dissimilarity of two augmented versions of an image, as shown in SimCLR [ 10 ] or between images and their corresponding captions, as in CLIP [ 31 ] . In standard contrastive learning, two views of an image form a positive pair. SupCon [ 32 ] reformulated contrastive learning into multi-positive pair contrastive learning by defining all images with the same label as positive samples. SupMAE [ 27 ] further extended the supervised setting into MIM by incorporating label-based supervision and reconstruction-based self-supervision.
blocks.zh: 相矛盾的学习通常会模拟一个图像的两个扩展版本的相似性和相异性,如SimCLR[10]所显示,或者如CLIP[31]所显示的在图像与其相应标题之间. 在标准对比性学习中,图像的两种观点形成正对. SupCon [32] 将对比性学习重新定义为多正对对比学习,将所有具有与正对标本相同标签的图像定义为正对标本. SupMAE[27]将监督设置进一步扩展为MIM,纳入基于标签的监督和重建的自监督。

blocks.en: II-E Semi-supervised learning
blocks.zh: II-E 半监督学习

blocks.en:
Semi-supervised learning leverages large amounts of unlabeled data alongside limited annotations. Common strategies include pseudo-labeling [ 33 ] and consistency regularization [ 34 ] , which encourage stable predictions under perturbations. Recent approaches combine these techniques with confidence-based filtering.
For instance, FixMatch [ 35 ] combined pseudo-labeling with confidence thresholds and consistency regularization, using a fixed threshold to retain only high-confidence predictions. FlexMatch [ 36 ] extended this by dynamically adjusting the confidence threshold per class, and SimMatch [ 37 ] added representation-level consistency, encouraging similar embeddings for augmented views of the same image.
MiTHras uses a teacher model trained on annotated MFs to assign pseudo labels to an unlabeled pretraining corpus. These pseudo labels supervise contrastive learning at both image and token levels–a process we term semi-supervised contrastive learning (SCL)–alongside self-supervised masked reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
半监督的学习带动了大量无标签的数据,同时还有有限的说明. 共同的战略包括伪标签[33]和一致性规范[34],鼓励在扰动下稳定的预测. 最近的办法将这些技术同基于信心的过滤结合起来。
例如,FixMatch [35] 将伪标签与信心阈值和一致性规范相结合,使用固定阈值只保留高自信预测. FlexMatch [36] 通过动态调整每类的置信阈值来扩展这一点,而SimMatch [37] 则增加了代表级别的一致性,鼓励类似嵌入,以用于增强对同一图像的视图.
MiTHras使用在附加说明的MF上受过训练的教师模型,将伪标签指定给一个没有标签的预训程序. 这些假标签监督图像和符号层面的对比性学习 — — 我们称之为半监督的对比性学习(SCL) — — 除了自我监督的蒙面重建之外。

blocks.en: III-A Pseudo-label dataset construction
blocks.zh: III-A Pseudo-label数据集构建

blocks.en: General-purpose pathology pretraining commonly uses tissue patches sampled without selecting a particular cell type. MF analysis instead requires discrimination of individual MFs from visually similar non-mitotic objects, or mimickers . We construct TCGA-MF-Pseudo to provide cell-centered crops sourced from 14 TCGA cohorts spanning 11 organ sites, with variations in tumor type, scanner, and staining protocols. The construction procedure has three stages:
blocks.zh: 一般目的病理预训通常使用被抽取而未选择特定细胞类型的组织补丁. 相反,MF分析要求从视觉上类似的非自体物体或mimickers中区分个人MF。 我们建造了TCGA-MF-Pseudo,提供来自14个TCGA组群的以细胞为中心的作物,这些组群跨越了11个器官地点,在肿瘤类型、扫描仪和污渍协议方面有变化。 施工程序分为三个阶段:

blocks.en: 1) Patch Extraction: We extract tissue patches of size 896 × \times 896 pixels using Otsu’s method [ 38 ] . Each extracted tile provides tissue context and is subdivided into a 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid of 224 × 224 224\times 224 patches for tumor filtering. The same tile also accommodates the 512 × 512 512\times 512 crops used by the segmentation stage.
blocks.zh: (1) 补丁提取器: 我们利用大津的方法提取出896×xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 被提取出的每一块瓷砖提供组织上下文,并被再细分为4×4 4\times 4格为224×224\times 224补丁来进行肿瘤过滤. 同样的瓦子还容纳了分层阶段使用的512×512 512\时的512个作物.

blocks.en: 2) Tumor Patch Selection: We select tumor patches if all 4 × \times 4 patches of size 224 × \times 224 pixels are predicted as tumors using IMPaSh [ 39 ] , a model classifying histology textures into adipose, background, debris, lymphocytes, mucus, smooth muscle, normal colon mucosa, cancer-associated stroma, and colorectal adenocarcinoma epithelium (tumor).
blocks.zh: (2) 肿瘤补丁选择 : 如果使用IMPaSh [39] 预测出4个大小的4个补丁,我们就会选择肿瘤补丁。 这个模型将组织纹理分类为脂肪、背景、碎片、淋巴细胞、黏液、平滑肌肉、正常结肠黏液、与癌症有关的血栓和结肠腺癌上腺素。

blocks.en:
3) Pseudo-Label Assignment. We detect and classify MF and mimicker candidates with the two-stage model of [ 18 ] trained on MIDOG22, replacing its stage-2 classifier with a ViT-base pretrained by MAE on ImageNet. From each refined centroid a 50 × \times 50 pixel pseudo bounding box is generated, following the MIDOG22 procedure. Candidates are selected via segmentation ( s seg s^{\text{seg}} ) and classification ( s cls s^{\text{cls}} ) scores. Pseudo MFs require s seg ≥ 0.1 s^{\text{seg}}\geq 0.1 and s cls > 0.5 s^{\text{cls}}>0.5 (660,831 crops), whereas a pseudo mimicker requires s seg ≥ 0.5 s^{\text{seg}}\geq 0.5 and s cls < 0.5 s^{\text{cls}}<0.5 (1,133,624 crops). Candidates with 0.1 ≤ s seg < 0.5 0.1\leq s^{\text{seg}}<0.5 and s cls < 0.5 s^{\text{cls}}<0.5 are excluded.
The lower segmentation threshold retains potential MFs, relying on the classifier to filter false positives. The higher threshold for mimickers selects candidates with strong segmentation responses that the classifier labels as non-mitotic. Pseudo-label quality is evaluated in Section V-F .
blocks.zh:
3) Pseudo-Label任务. 我们用在MIDOG22上受过训练的[18]的双相机模型来检测和分类MF和micker候选人,用一个由MEAE在ImageNet上预先训练的ViT基位来取而代之. 从每个被精制的百分位机器人中产生出一个50×\times 50像素伪界框,遵循了MIDOG22程序. 考生通过分区(seg s^{\text{seg}}})和分级(s cls s^{\text{cls}}})分数选出. Pseudo MFs要求以0.1 s^{\text{seg}}\geq 6.1和cls > 0.5 s^{\text{cls}}> 0.5 (660,831个作物)为单位,而假的mimicker要求以0.5 s^{\text{seg}}\geq 0.5和cls < 0.5 s^{\text{cls}}< 0.5(1,133,624个作物)。 候选人中,0.1 + seg < 0.5 0.1\leq s^{\text{seg}}<0.5和cls < 0.5 s^{\text{cls}}<0.5被排除在外。
下分解阈值保留了潜在的MF,依靠分解器来过滤假阳性. mimickers的更高的门槛选择了具有强烈分解响应的候选者,被该类者分类为"非分解". V-F节评价了Pseudo-label的质量。

blocks.en: Following this procedure, we obtain a task-specific MF pretraining dataset, referred to as TCGA-MF-Pseudo , which comprises 660,831 pseudo MF images and 1,133,624 pseudo mimicker images. Figure 2 illustrates the proportions of the datasets used in this study. Compared to other datasets, TCGA-MF-Pseudo is not only larger in terms of MFs and mimicker images but also covers a broader range of tumor types and data sources.
blocks.zh: 根据这一程序,我们获得一个任务专用的MF预训数据集,称为TCGA-MF-Pseudo(TCGA-MF-Pseudo),由660,831个伪MF图像和1,133,624个伪密克图像组成. 图2显示了本研究所使用的数据集的比例。 与其他数据集相比,TCGA-MF-Pseudo不仅在MF和micker图像方面较大,而且还涵盖更广泛的肿瘤类型和数据来源.

blocks.en: To assess the effectiveness of task-specific pretraining, we also construct an unlabeled pathology pretraining dataset, referred to as TCGA-Unlabeled , following the standard SSL approach in computational pathology. This dataset consists of 8 million patches (224 × \times 224 pixels) extracted from the same 14 cohorts at multiple magnifications: 3 million patches at 40 × \times , 2.7 million patches at 20 × \times , 1.2 million patches at 10 × \times , and 1.1 million patches at 5 × \times magnification.
blocks.zh: 为了评估特定任务预训的有效性,我们还按照计算病理的标准SSL方法,构建了一个无标签的病理预训数据集,称为TCGA-无标签. 本数据集由从同14个群中提取的多放大的800万个补丁(224×224像素)组成:40××分3百万个补丁;20×分270万个补丁;10×分120万个补丁;5×分110万个补丁.

blocks.en: We note that IMPaSh was trained to recognize colorectal tissue categories and is applied here across multiple organ sites. Its role is to select tissue regions, while the separate MIDOG22-trained detector and classifier assign MF and mimicker labels.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,IMPaSh接受了识别分泌组织类别的培训,并被应用于多个器官场所。 它的作用是选择组织区域,而单独的MIDOG22训练的探测器和分级器则指定了MF和Mimicker标签.

blocks.en: III-B MiTHras pretraining
blocks.zh: III-B 米塔拉斯预训

blocks.en: Figure 1 B details the architecture of the MiTHras pretraining procedure, which comprises five main components:
blocks.zh: 图1 B详细介绍了MITHras预训程序的结构,该程序由五个主要部分组成:

blocks.en: 1) Augmentation and Masking : Each image is randomly augmented and partially masked to generate two different views composed of visible and masked image tiles.
blocks.zh: 1)增强和遮罩:每个图像被随机地放大并被部分遮罩来生成由可见和被遮罩的图像平板组成的两个不同视图.

blocks.en: 2) Encoder ( f enc f^{\text{enc}} ) : The visible tiles are passed through a ViT encoder to generate latent feature representations, including a [CLS] token that summarizes the image-level information.
blocks.zh: 2)编码器(f enc f^{\text{enc}}}: 可见的瓦片会通过一个ViT编码器来生成潜在的特征表示,包括一个[CLS]符号来总结图像级别的信息.

blocks.en: 3) SCL-global module : An image-level projection head f img f^{\text{img}} extracts global embeddings from the encoder output, which are trained to align with others from the same pseudo-label class while being distinct from those of different classes.
blocks.zh: (3) SCL-全球模块: 一个图像平面投影头f img f^{\text{img}}}从编码器输出中提取出全局嵌入,这些嵌入被训练成与同一伪标签类的其他人对齐,同时区别于不同类的.

blocks.en: 4) SCL-local module : A separate token-level projection head f tok f^{\text{tok}} captures fine-grained, tile-level features. Tokens sharing the same pseudo-label are encouraged to cluster together.
blocks.zh: (4) SCL-本地模块: 一个单独的符号级投影头 f tok f^{\text{tok}}}捕获精细的,平板级的特性. 鼓励共享相同伪标签的托肯组合在一起.

blocks.en: 5) Decoder ( f dec f^{\text{dec}} ) : A lightweight decoder reconstructs the original image from visible and masked tokens, using a pixel-wise loss to enforce reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 5) 解码器(f dec f^{\text{dec}}) : 轻量级的解码器从可见和被遮掩的符号上重建出原始的图像,使用像素偏差来强制重建质量.

blocks.en: The following subsections describe each component in detail and explain how they are integrated within the MiTHras framework.

blocks.en: III-D Mitotic figure detection model
blocks.zh: 三-D 中期数字探测模型

blocks.en: The detection model follows the two-stage pipeline of Jahanifar et al. [ 18 ] . A segmentation model proposes candidate locations, and the MF-versus-mimicker classifier evaluates a crop around each candidate. We write this pipeline as f det = f cls ∘ f seg f^{\text{det}}=f^{\text{cls}}\circ f^{\text{seg}} , with candidate extraction and cropping included between the two stages.
blocks.zh: 检测模型沿用了贾哈尼法尔等的两级管线 [18]. 一个分块模式提出了候选地点,而MF---micker分类法对每个候选地点周围的一棵作物进行评价. 我们把这个管道写成 f det = f cls = seg f s^{\text { det}}=f^{\text { cls}}\circ f^{\text { seg}}},在两个阶段之间包含候选提取和裁剪.

blocks.en: In the first stage, we use an Efficient-UNet-b0 segmentation model f seg f^{\text{seg}} to process an input image and generate a probability map, highlighting candidate regions for mitotic figures. Candidate MFs are then identified by applying morphological post-processing to this map. For each candidate, the centroid is extracted, and the mean intensity within the region is used as the detection score s seg s^{\text{seg}} . In the second stage, each candidate is classified using the mitotic classification model f cls f^{\text{cls}} , as described in Section III-C , yielding a classification score s cls s^{\text{cls}} . The stages are trained independently. For each two-stage method, a single pair of segmentation and classification thresholds is selected by maximizing F 1 across the three MIDOG22 validation folds and is then held fixed for external evaluation. The candidate detector is shared across second-stage classifiers.
blocks.zh: 在第一阶段,我们使用一个高效-UNet-b0分块模型 feg f^{\text{seg}}}处理一个输入图像并生成一个概率图,突出模拟数字的候选区域. 候选人 然后通过将形态后处理法应用到这张地图中来识别出MF. 对于每个候选者,取出百分数,并使用区域内的平均烈度作为检测分数seg s^{\text{seg}}. 在第二阶段,每个考生都使用第三-C节所描述的相模分类模型fcls f^{\text{cls}}}进行分类,得出分类分数 s sls s^{\text{cls}}. 阶段由独立培训。 对于每个两相方法,通过在MIDOG22的三种验证折叠上将F 1最大化来选择一对单相分和分类阈值,然后被固定用于外部评价. 候选探测器由第二阶段的分级器共享。

blocks.en: During inference, the segmentation model processes 512 × 512 512\times 512 windows with a stride of 400 pixels, and overlapping probability maps are averaged. The 112-pixel overlap reduces boundary effects while limiting repeated computation. This setting follows the MDFS protocol [ 18 ] ; its approximate processing redundancy is ( 512 / 400 ) 2 = 1.64 (512/400)^{2}=1.64 , compared with 4 4 for a half-window stride.
blocks.zh: 在推论期间,分块模型会处理512×512 512\times 512个窗口,并有400像素的阶梯,相重叠概率图被平均. 112-像素重叠可以减少边界效应,同时限制重复计算. 此设置遵循了 MDFS 协议 [18]; 其近似处理冗余为 (512/400) 2 = 1.64 (512/400) *=2= 1.64 与 4 4 为半窗口出步.

blocks.en: III-E MiTHras mitotic count for WSIs
blocks.zh: III-E 微缩线的Mithras相位计

blocks.en:
We apply the two-stage detector to WSIs and summarize the detections using a hotspot count in 2 ​ mm 2 2\,\mathrm{mm}^{2} and a density expressed per 20 ​ mm 2 20\,\mathrm{mm}^{2} . The hotspot summarizes the most active sampled region, whereas density summarizes average activity across the analyzed tissue. These count-derived features are evaluated for survival prediction on TCGA-THCA and TCGA-GBMLGG.
For both the mitotic hotspot (2 mm 2 ) and mitotic density (20 mm 2 ) strategies, we begin by applying Otsu [ 38 ] thresholding to extract tissue patches from a WSI. The patches are of size 512 × \times 512 pixels acquired at 40 × \times magnification (0.25 μ \mu m per pixel). Each patch is then processed using the two-stage mitotic detection pipeline to identify MFs.
blocks.zh:
我们在WSIs上应用了双相探测器,并使用2mm 2\,\mathrm{mm}^{2}的热点计数和每20mm 2 20\,\mathrm{mm}^{2}的密度来总结检测结果. 热点汇总了最活跃的抽样区域,而密度则汇总了所分析组织的平均活性。 对TCGA-THCA和TCGA-GBMLGG进行生存预测时,对这些取自的特征进行评价。
对于线粒体热点(2毫米2)和线粒体密度(20毫米2)两种策略,我们首先应用Otsu[38]阈值从一个WSI中取出组织补丁. 补丁为大小为512×\times 512像素以40×\times放大(每像素0.25μ\m)获得. 每个补丁再用两相相位检测管进行处理来识别MF.

blocks.en: III-E 1 Mitotic hotspot (2 mm 2 )
blocks.zh: 三-E 1 水上热点(2毫米2)

blocks.en: Local Max ROI Counting (LMRC) centers a square of area 2 ​ mm 2 2\,\mathrm{mm}^{2} on each detected MF and returns the largest count among these candidate regions. Detected coordinates are indexed with a KD-tree ( cKDTree , SciPy v1.11.2). A Chebyshev-distance query retrieves points within each square using a half-side length of 2 / 2 \sqrt{2}/2 mm. The procedure avoids evaluating a dense sliding grid; its search is restricted to detection-centered squares.
blocks.zh: 本地的 Max ROI 计数( LMRC) 将面积为 2 mm 2\,\ mathrm{ mm\ 2} 的平方放在每个检测到的 MF 上, 并返回这些候选区域中的最大数 。 被探测到的坐标以KD-tree(cKDtree,SciPy v1.11.2)索引。 一个切比舍夫-距离查询在每平方内部取出点,使用半边长为2 / 2\ sqrt{2}/2 mm. 该程序避免评价密集的滑行网;其搜索仅限于以检测为中心平方.

blocks.en: III-E 2 Mitotic density (20 mm 2 )
blocks.zh: III-E 2. 光线密度(20毫米2)

blocks.en: Mitotic density expresses the total detected MF count per unit of analyzed tissue area, with 20 ​ mm 2 20\,\mathrm{mm}^{2} used as the reporting reference. Unlike the hotspot count, it summarizes average activity across the sampled tissue.
blocks.zh: Mitotic密度表示每个被分析的组织区域单位被检测出的总MF计数,20mm 2 20\,\mathrm{mm}^{2}作为报告参考. 与热点计数不同,它总结了整个被抽样组织的平均活性.

blocks.en: III-F Mitotic figure subtype classification model
blocks.zh: III-F 中期图分类型分类模型

blocks.en: Similar to the MF classification model f cls f^{\text{cls}} , we build two subtype classification models: f cls-br f^{\text{cls-br}} for the binary classification of mitotic figure subtypes and f cls-morph f^{\text{cls-morph}} for the 8-class morphological subtype classification.
blocks.zh: 与MF分类模型fls f^{\text{cls}}}相似,我们构建了两个子类型分类模型:fcls-br f^{\text{cls-br}}}用于平面图子类型二进制分类和fcls-morph f^{\text{cls-morph}} 用于8级形态子类型分类.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: IV-A Datasets
blocks.zh: 数据集

blocks.en:
We evaluate four tasks, mitotic figure classification, detection, survival prediction from mitotic count, and subtype classification, across the datasets detailed in Table II and Figure 2 .
The TCGA evaluation cancer types (GBM, SARC, DLBC, THCA, and LGG) are excluded from TCGA-MF-Pseudo. TCGA pretraining and evaluation therefore share no slide, patient, or cancer type. TCGA metadata show no overlap in tissue source site codes, although 20 of the 33 parent institutions contributing to the evaluation cohorts also contribute to the pretraining cohorts. The TCGA split therefore evaluates transfer across cancer types but does not establish independence of institutional acquisition practices. MIDOGpp, Canine, AMi-Br-TUPAC, and AMi-Morph-TUPAC provide additional external evaluations across laboratories, scanners, and, for Canine, species.
blocks.zh:
我们通过表二和图2所详述的数据集,评估了四项任务:线粒体数字分类、检测、线粒体计数中的生存预测和亚类分类。
TCGA评价癌症类型(GBM、SARC、DLBC、THCA和LGG)被排除在TCGA-MF-Pseudo之外。 因此,TCGA预训和评价没有幻灯片、病人或癌症类型。 TCGA元数据显示组织源址代码没有重叠,尽管33个参与评价组的母机构中有20个也参与培训前组。 因此,TCGA的分裂评估了癌症类型之间的转移,但没有确立机构获取做法的独立性。 MIDOGpp、Canine、Ami-Br-TUPAC和Ami-Morph-TUPAC提供了跨实验室、扫描仪和对Canine的物种的额外外部评价。

blocks.en: IV-A 1 Pretraining and training data
blocks.zh: IV-A 1 预训和培训数据

blocks.en: TCGA-MF-Pseudo (Section III-A ) provides 660,831 pseudo MFs and 1,133,624 pseudo mimickers for pretraining. For supervised training we adopt MIDOG22 [ 9 ] , containing 9,501 MFs and 11,051 mimickers from 354 images across five tumor types: 150 human breast carcinomas, 44 canine lung carcinomas, 55 canine lymphosarcomas, 50 canine cutaneous mast cell tumors, and 55 human neuroendocrine tumors. Following the three-fold MDFS training protocol [ 18 ] , we train Efficient-UNet-b0 for candidate segmentation and reuse this segmentation stage for all second-stage classifier comparisons. The three train/validation splits contain 239/115, 234/120, and 235/119 source images, respectively, with no image overlap between training and validation within a split. We extract 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixel patches for segmentation and 128 × 128 128\times 128 pixel crops centered on MFs and mimickers for classification, and select the best classification checkpoint per fold by validation performance. Each fold is trained and evaluated independently. Results are reported as the mean ± \pm standard deviation across three folds, without ensembling predictions. All methods use the same folds. The standard deviation describes variation across training folds.

blocks.en: IV-A 2 Tasks 1 and 2: classification and detection
blocks.zh: 任务1和2:分类和检测

blocks.en: Both tasks are evaluated on MIDOGpp, Canine, and TCGA-MF-Test. MIDOGpp contains 2,436 MFs and 3,300 mimickers from 100 canine soft tissue sarcoma and 49 human melanoma images. Canine includes 7,206 MFs and 3,082 mimickers from 160 canine cutaneous mast cell tumor and 105 canine mammary tumor images [ 40 , 41 ] . TCGA-MF-Test comprises 1,539 MFs and 2,073 mimickers from TCGA glioblastoma multiforme (GBM), soft tissue sarcoma (SARC), and lymphoid neoplasm diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBC).
blocks.zh: 这两项任务均在MIDOGpp、Canine和TCGA-MF-Test上得到评价。 MIDOGpp包含出自100个犬类软组织 sarcoma和49个人类黑色素瘤图像的2,436个MF和3,300个mimiickers. 犬类包括7,206MF和出自160只犬皮下乳头细胞瘤的3,082mimiickers和105个犬皮乳头瘤图像[40,41]. TCGA-MF-试验包括1 539个MF和2 073个来自TCGA胶原瘤多型体(GBM)、软组织沙尔科马(SARC)和淋巴肿瘤扩散出大型B细胞淋巴瘤(DLBC)。

blocks.en: For classification, we extract 128 × 128 128\times 128 pixels centered on annotated centroids. Evaluation metrics are defined in Section IV-C . For detection, we use full images: segmentation probability maps are produced via a 512 × 512 512\times 512 sliding window at stride 400 and aggregated by averaging overlaps. Peak points define candidate locations, from which 128 × 128 128\times 128 patches are extracted and classified. Predictions are matched to ground truth within a 30-pixel radius and scored by F 1 .

blocks.en: IV-A 3 Task 3: Survival prediction using mitotic count
blocks.zh: 任务3:利用线粒体计数进行存活预测

blocks.en: Given the role of mitotic count in grading high-grade follicular-cell-derived thyroid carcinoma [ 2 ] and diffuse glioma, we evaluate its association with overall survival across two cohorts: TCGA-THCA (406 thyroid WSIs from 395 patients, including 11 deaths) and TCGA-GBMLGG (844 brain WSIs from 501 patients, including 122 deaths). The slides were scanned at 40 × 40\times magnification. Survival time is measured in months, with death coded as the event ( event = 1 − censorship \mathrm{event}=1-\mathrm{censorship} ).

blocks.en: IV-A 4 Task 4: Mitotic figure subtype classification
blocks.zh: IV-A 4 任务4:中期数字亚类分类

blocks.en: We evaluate generalization on two subtype benchmarks [ 42 ] : AMi-Br (typical vs. atypical) and AMi-Morph (eight morphology classes), used to evaluate f cls-br f^{\text{cls-br}} and f cls-morph f^{\text{cls-morph}} respectively. Three-fold cross-validation is performed on AMi-Br-MIDOG21 and AMi-Morph-MIDOG21. Each fold model is applied independently to the held-out AMi-Br-TUPAC and AMi-Morph-TUPAC domains, and results are reported as the mean ± \pm standard deviation over the three folds. AMi-Br-MIDOG21 contains 1,721 figures (1,317 typical, 404 atypical); AMi-Morph-MIDOG21 adds eight-way annotations to the same images from two experts, of which we use expert 1 (four typical subtypes: prometaphase, metaphase, ring-shaped, anaphase-telophase; four atypical: bipolar asymmetric, multipolar, segregation-related, other), with the rarest class holding 18 examples. The test sets are AMi-Br-TUPAC (1,999 figures; 1,571 typical, 428 atypical) and AMi-Morph-TUPAC (1,999 figures across the same eight subtypes). AMi-Br is scored by positive-class F 1 for atypical figures, and AMi-Morph by macro F 1 over the morphology classes.

AMi-Br-MIDOG21包含有1,721个数字(1,317个典型数字,404个非典型数字);AMi-Morph-MIDOG21为两个专家的同名图像添加了八向注释,其中我们使用专家一(四个典型的子类型:相模相,元相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 测试集为AMI-Br-TUPAC(1,999个数字;1,571个典型,428个非典型)和AMI-Morph-TUPAC(1,999个数字横跨同8个子类型). blocks.en: IV-B Implementation details
blocks.zh: 四-B 执行细节

blocks.en:
We trained all the pretraining models for 200 epochs on 8 NVIDIA A6000 GPUs. MiTHras was initialized from scratch and optimized with AdamW (betas 0.9 0.9 and 0.95 0.95 , weight decay 0.05 0.05 ), an effective batch size of 512 512 , and a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , with 10 warm-up epochs followed by cosine decay. The configuration without MIM used the same image/token weights ( 0.75 / 0.25 0.75/0.25 ) and optimizer schedule, with an effective batch size of 768 768 and learning rate of 4.5 × 10 − 4 4.5\times 10^{-4} . The masking ratio was fixed at α = 0.75 \alpha=0.75 , following MAE [ 11 ] , while the ablations varied β \beta to assess the balance of the image- and token-level SCL objectives. During pretraining, two augmented views were generated per image, following the procedure described in Section III-B4 . Views were normalized with ImageNet statistics.
All classification models were fine-tuned for 50 epochs on a single NVIDIA A6000, with RandAugment plus random erasing, 224 × 224 224\times 224 inputs, ImageNet normalization, label smoothing ( ϵ = 0.1 \epsilon=0.1 ), AdamW (weight decay 0.05, layer-wise decay 0.75), base learning rate 2.5 × 10 − 4 2.5\times 10^{-4} with five warm-up epochs, and automatic mixed precision. The segmentation model was trained separately for 50 epochs on 2 A6000 GPUs at 512 × 512 512\times 512 with standard augmentation and optimization.

For linear probing, the frozen pretrained encoder was attached to a classification head consisting of an affine-free batch normalization layer followed by a trainable linear layer. The head was trained using LARS with a base learning rate of 0.1, zero weight decay, 10 warm-up epochs, cosine decay, and cross-entropy loss. Images were resized to 224 × \times 224 pixels with weak augmentation and ImageNet normalization. Affine-free batch normalization standardized feature scales across backbones. All methods used the same three folds and 50-epoch training budget for linear probing and fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
我们在8个NVIDIA A6000 GPU上为200个时代的所有预训模型进行了训练. MITHras从零开始被初始化,并和AdamW(βs 0.9和 0.95 0.95,重量衰减 0.05 0.05),有效批量大小为512 512,学习率为3×10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4},有10个发热的纪元后有余弦衰变. 没有MIM的配置使用了相同的图像/托起重量(0.75/0.25 0.75/0.25)并优化了进度表,有效批量大小为768 768,学习率为4.5×10−4 4.5\times 10^{-4}. 遮掩比被固定为α = 0.75\alpha = 0.75,跟随MAE [11],而平面变化为β\β来评估图像-和符号级SCL目标的平衡. 在预训期间,按照第三节B4所描述的程序,每个图像产生了两种扩大的视图。 视图已与ImageNet统计数据正常化。
所有分类模型均在单NVIDIA A6000上对50个纪元进行了微调,RandAugment加随机去除,224×224\times 224输入,ImageNet正常化,标签平滑(QQ=0.1\epsilon=0.1),AdamW(重量衰减0.05,分层衰减0.75),基础学习速率2.5×10−4 2.5\tims 10×4)有5个暖化纪元,自动混合精度. 分化模式在2个A6000 GPU上为50个时代单独训练了512×512512\times 512并有标准的增强和优化.

对于线性探测,被冷冻的预受试编码器被附加在一个由无同位素的批量正常化层所组成的分类头上,再再再附加可受试的线性层. 头部使用LARS进行训练,基础学习率为0.1分,零重量衰减,10个发热纪元,余弦衰减,并有交叉收缩. 图像被调整为224x\times 224像素,并具有弱的增强和ImageNet正常化. 无烟分批正常化 跨骨干区标准化特色规模. 所有方法都使用相同的三叠相和50个世纪的训练预算进行线性测试和微调.

blocks.en: IV-C Evaluation metrics and statistical analysis
blocks.zh: IV-C 评价指标和统计分析

blocks.en: We evaluate performance using accuracy (ACC), precision, recall, F 1 score, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC). For mitotic-versus-mimicker classification, MFs are the positive class. For AMi-Br, atypical figures (label 1) are positive and typical figures (label 0) are negative. Binary precision, recall, and F 1 are calculated for the positive class. For AMi-Morph, these metrics are calculated separately for each class occurring in the targets or predictions and averaged with equal class weights (unweighted macro averaging); undefined class scores are set to zero. ROC-AUC is not evaluated for AMi-Morph. Detection metrics use predicted locations matched to annotated MFs within a 30-pixel radius.
blocks.zh: 我们使用精度(ACC)、精度、回溯、F 1分和接收器操作特征曲线下的区域(ROC-AUC)来评价性能。 对于线粒体-相模分类,MF是正分类. 对于AMI-Br,非典型数字(label 1)为正数,典型数字(label 0)为正数. 二进制精度,回想,和F 1为正分级计算. 对AMI-Morph来说,这些度量衡是针对目标或预测中发生的每个分级分别计算出,并以等分级权重(未加权的宏平均值)进行平均值;未定义的分级被设定为零. ROC-AUC不为AMI-Morph评价. 检测指标使用30像素半径范围内与附加说明的MF相匹配的预测位置。

blocks.en: Survival prediction is evaluated using Harrell’s concordance index (C-index), which measures agreement between predicted risk and observed event ordering among comparable pairs, accounting for censoring. Cox proportional-hazards models are fitted and evaluated within each full cohort. Patients with multiple slides contribute multiple observations. 95% confidence intervals are calculated using 1,000 WSI resamples with fitted risk predictions held fixed, i.e., without refitting the Cox models. Log-rank tests compare groups defined by a cutpoint fixed at the median of the designated training subset. A likelihood-ratio test compares a model containing age and sex with one additionally containing the mitotic-count feature. Reported p-values are unadjusted.

blocks.en: IV-D 6 Blinded pathological review

blocks.en:
A single pathologist (P.T.H.H.) conducted a blinded review to assess tissue selection and pseudo-label quality across all 14 cohorts. Only the images were provided, and the pipeline labels and confidence scores were concealed. For tissue selection, IMPaSh and CONCH [ 51 ] were applied to 10,000 sampled patches per cohort. The reviewer examined 25 patches per cohort from each of three strata: retained by both filters, retained only by IMPaSh, and retained only by CONCH, yielding 1,050 reviewed patches. For pseudo-label quality, the audit included 700 crop reviews, comprising 420 pseudo-mitotic and 280 pseudo-mimicker reviews (30 and 20 per cohort, respectively) from the final pretraining corpus. Each crop was classified as confirmed, not confirmed, or unsure. Precision ranges count unsure verdicts as incorrect at the lower endpoint and correct at the upper endpoint. Per-cohort proportions are reported with Wilson confidence intervals. Tumor-filter stratum estimates pool the reviewed patches; pooled pseudo-mitotic precision is also reported with weights proportional to each cohort’s pseudo-mitotic pool size. The additional-figure assessment included 199 pseudo-mimicker crops whose central candidate was classified as non-mitotic. For each crop, the reviewer recorded whether an MF was present elsewhere in the crop. For bounding-box assessment, MFs confirmed during the crop review were assigned to the smallest enclosing square category: 25, 50, 75, or larger than 75 pixels. No additional crops were
sampled for this assessment.

MiTHras attained the highest mean F 1 across all three test sets (Table III ). Under full fine-tuning, its margins over the strongest baseline, Virchow, were 0.016 0.016 on MIDOGpp, 0.011 0.011 on Canine, and 0.002 0.002 on TCGA-MF-Test, though the latter difference was small relative to the reported fold variability.
This gap widened under linear probing. MiTHras achieved F 1 scores of 0.836 0.836 , 0.848 0.848 , and 0.775 0.775 on MIDOGpp, Canine, and TCGA-MF-Test, respectively, with reductions of 0.007 0.007 – 0.028 0.028 from full fine-tuning. On MIDOGpp, the best general-purpose or pathology foundation encoder reached 0.421 0.421 , while all encoders exceeding 0.45 0.45 were pretrained on labeled or pseudo-labeled MF data. These results indicate that MiTHras features are more readily applicable without complex tuning.

blocks.en:
The effect of the pretraining corpus varies with the objective and evaluation protocol. Supervised ViT pretraining on TCGA-MF-Pseudo produced substantially higher linear-probing F 1 than supervised ImageNet pretraining on all three datasets. For MAE, TCGA-MF-Pseudo improved linear probing over ImageNet universally, but fine-tuning results were mixed, with lower F 1 on MIDOGpp and TCGA-MF-Test and identical F 1 on Canine. MiTHras exceeded all three MAE baselines under both protocols, supporting the contribution of task-specific SCL beyond masked reconstruction.
Among pathology foundation models, Virchow attained the highest fine-tuned F 1 on all three datasets, outperforming smaller encoders such as CTransPath-MoCov3 [ 12 ] and CHIEF [ 44 ] .

blocks.en:
Table IV compares detection performance. MiTHras obtained the highest mean F 1 on MIDOGpp ( 0.829 0.829 ) and TCGA-MF-Test ( 0.599 0.599 ), and was comparable to the best model (GPFM) on Canine (0.797 vs. 0.798). Differences among second-stage classifiers were smaller than in the classification experiment, as the shared first-stage detector constrains candidate recall. Nevertheless, most two-stage models outperformed the standalone segmentation model f seg f^{\text{seg}} , confirming that the second stage contributes by separating true MFs from mimickers.
Among the two-stage methods, SupMAE, pretrained on the smaller labeled MIDOG22 corpus, yielded the lowest mean F 1 on all three test sets. Foundation-model rankings varied by dataset: Virchow led this group on MIDOGpp and TCGA-MF-Test, whereas GPFM led on Canine.

在两个阶段的方法中,SupMAE在标有更小标签的MIDOG22套设备上预作训练,在所有三个测试装置上均分为最低的F 1。 基础模型排名因数据集而异: Virchow在MIDOGpp和TCGA-MF-Test上领导这个小组,而GPFM则领导了Canine.

blocks.en:
Correlation with Diagnostic Subtypes. We compared mitotic counts produced by MiTHras under the two counting strategies, mitotic hotspot (2 mm 2 ) and mitotic density (20 mm 2 ), for two diagnostic tasks in TCGA-GBMLGG (Figure 4 ): the lower-grade glioma (LGG) and glioblastoma (GBM) cohorts, and grade 2 versus 3 versus 4.
Median mitotic counts increased with tumor grade under both strategies (median hotspot count 5 in LGG versus 17 in GBM; 4, 6 and 17 across grades 2–4).
The two strategies diverged mainly on the intermediate grades: hotspot counts for grades 2 and 3 are nearly indistinguishable (medians 4 and 6), whereas density shows a larger difference in group medians (11 and 23).
blocks.zh:
与诊断子型的关联. 我们比较了MITHras在两个计数策略下制作的线粒体计数,即线粒体热点(2毫米2)和线粒体密度(20毫米2),用于TCGA-GBMLGG(图4)的两个诊断任务:低等胶原(LGG)和胶原(GBM)群,以及2等对3等对4等.
在这两种战略下,中间线粒体计数随着肿瘤分数的增加而增加(LGG的中间热点计数为5;GBM的中间热点计数为17;2-4年级的中间热点计数为4、6和17)。
这两项战略主要在中级年级上存在差异:2年级和3年级的热点计数几乎是无法区分的(医学家4和6),而密度显示组群中位数(11和23)差异较大。

blocks.en:
Survival Prediction. Table V reports the apparent C-index and 95% bootstrap confidence interval for each count-based Cox model. On TCGA-GBMLGG, MiTHras obtained C-indices of 0.627 0.627 (hotspot) and 0.671 0.671 (density). On TCGA-THCA, all point estimates fell below 0.5 0.5 , with MiTHras yielding 0.446 0.446 (95% CI 0.313 0.313 – 0.607 0.607 ) for hotspot and 0.427 0.427 ( 0.287 0.287 – 0.593 0.593 ) for density. Given only 11 events across 395 patients (406 WSIs), these results are reported descriptively.
These C-indices evaluate mitotic count as a single morphological predictor. Samples with identical counts receive identical predicted risks, and these ties receive half credit in Harrell’s C-index. Consequently, differences between methods reflect variations in detection coverage as well as actual biological variations across slides. We therefore present these cohort-level associations as an exploratory assessment of automated mitotic counting.
blocks.zh:
生存预测。 页:1 V报告每个基于计数的Cox模型的明显C-index和95%的靴子置信间隔. 在TCGA-GBMLGG上,MITHras获得了0.627 0.627 (热点)和0.671 0.671 (密度)的C-indices. 在TCGA-THCA上,所有点数估计都降到了0.5 0.5以下,MITHras的收成为:热点0.446 0.446 (95% CI 0.313 0.313 – 0.607 0.607),密度0.427 0.427 (0.287 0.293 – 0.593). 由于在395名病人中只有11起事件(406起西安事件),这些结果被描述性地报告。
这些C-indices评价相位计是一个单一的形态预测器. 计算相同的样本得到相同的预测风险,这些关联在哈雷尔的C-index中获得了一半的信用. 因此,方法之间的差异反映了探测范围的变化以及不同幻灯片中的实际生物变化。 因此,我们提出这些团体协会是对自动线粒体计数的探索性评估。

Table VI presents MF subtype classification results. MiTHras achieved the highest mean F 1 on both benchmarks: 0.700 0.700 on AMi-Br-TUPAC and 0.483 0.483 on AMi-Morph-TUPAC, outperforming the strongest baselines by 0.046 0.046 and 0.031 0.031 , respectively.

Eight-class morphology remains challenging, yielding a maximum macro F 1 of 0.483 0.483 , in which the metric differs from the positive-class F 1 used for AMi-Br.

blocks.en:
Table VII shows the effect of loss components, β \beta , backbone, and pretraining corpus. Regarding the loss components, masked reconstruction ( ℒ M ​ I ​ M \mathcal{L}_{MIM} ) alone performed poorly. Incorporating image-level SCL ( ℒ S ​ C ​ L i ​ m ​ g \mathcal{L}_{SCL}^{img} ) substantially improved performance, increasing F 1 across all eight evaluations and raising the descriptive mean from 0.544 0.544 to 0.766 0.766 , with the largest gains observed in subtype classification.
Notably, ℒ S ​ C ​ L i ​ m ​ g \mathcal{L}_{SCL}^{img} alone produced variable results across datasets. These results indicate that neither term alone is sufficient for consistent and reliable performance.

值得注意的是,仅L S C L i m g \ mathcal{L}_{ SCL}^{img}就产生了跨数据集的可变结果. 这些结果表明,单凭两个术语都不足以实现一致和可靠的业绩。

blocks.en:
Incorporating token-level SCL ( ℒ S ​ C ​ L t ​ o ​ k \mathcal{L}_{SCL}^{tok} ) produced task-dependent trade-offs. Relative to using ℒ M ​ I ​ M \mathcal{L}_{MIM} and ℒ S ​ C ​ L i ​ m ​ g \mathcal{L}_{SCL}^{img} ( β = 1.0 \beta=1.0 ), the main configuration ( β = 0.75 \beta=0.75 ) enhanced the overall mean from 0.766 0.766 to 0.769 0.769 but yielded mixed task-level results: AMi-Br F 1 improved from 0.667 0.667 to 0.700 0.700 , while AMi-Morph F 1 dropped from 0.494 0.494 to 0.483 0.483 . Fine-tuned MF-versus-mimicker F 1 decreased marginally by 0.001 − 0.010 0.001-0.010 across MIDOGpp, Canine, and TCGA-MF-Test. Linear probing showed gains for Canine ( + 0.009 +0.009 ) and TCGA-MF-Test ( + 0.016 +0.016 ), but a drop for MIDOGpp ( − 0.011 -0.011 ). Thus, token-level supervision does not consistently improve fine morphological discrimination.

Moreover, excluding ℒ M ​ I ​ M \mathcal{L}_{MIM} ( 0.75 ​ ℒ S ​ C ​ L i ​ m ​ g + 0.25 ​ ℒ S ​ C ​ L t ​ o ​ k 0.75\mathcal{L}_{SCL}^{img}+0.25\mathcal{L}_{SCL}^{tok} ) had divergent effects under fine-tuning and linear probing. It lowered F 1 on all three fine-tuned MF-versus-mimicker benchmarks, yet produced mixed linear-probing results: MIDOGpp and TCGA-MF-Test increased, while Canine decreased. AMi-Br remained at 0.700 0.700 , but AMi-Morph decreased from 0.483 0.483 to 0.475 0.475 .

With ViT-tiny, β = 0.75 \beta=0.75 improved all three linear-probing and both subtype results over β = 1 \beta=1 , while lowering all three fine-tuned MF-versus-mimicker results. ViT-tiny approached ViT-base in binary classification, though its AMi-Morph F 1 remained lower. For ViT-base at β = 0.75 \beta=0.75 , pretraining on TCGA-MF-Pseudo produced an eight-evaluation mean of 0.769 0.769 , surpassing 0.684 0.684 obtained with labeled MIDOG22, highlighting the benefits of the larger scale and diversity of the pseudo-labeled corpus.

blocks.en:
To assess the impact of the tumor filter, we compared IMPaSh and CONCH. IMPaSh retained 14.7 % 14.7\% of the sampled patches, compared with 27.0 % 27.0\% for CONCH. In the pathologist-reviewed disagreement strata, pooled tumor precision was 87.7 87.7 – 95.4 % 95.4\% for patches retained only by IMPaSh and 87.7 87.7 – 92.9 % 92.9\% for patches retained only by CONCH (Table VIII ).
Performance varied across cohorts, with neither filter consistently achieving higher precision. In downstream evaluation at β = 0.75 \beta=0.75 , replacing IMPaSh with CONCH decreased the eight-evaluation mean F 1 from 0.769 0.769 to 0.765 0.765 . At β = 1 \beta=1 , the corresponding means were comparable ( 0.766 0.766 vs. 0.767 0.767 ; Table VII ). Overall, although some individual subtype variations were larger, the aggregate differences remained minor.

blocks.en: V-F Pseudo-label quality
blocks.zh: V-F Pseudo标签质量

blocks.en:
The blinded review of 420 pseudo-mitotic review records yielded pool-weighted precision of 94.9 94.9 – 98.1 % 98.1\% (unweighted: 92.9 92.9 – 97.1 % 97.1\% ; Table IX ). In the additional-figure assessment, 8 of the 199 crops ( 4.02 % 4.02\% ; 95% Wilson CI, 2.05 2.05 – 7.73 % 7.73\% ) contained another MF, indicating that crops centered on non-mitotic objects can still capture peripheral MFs, introducing errors into pseudo labels.
The bounding-box assessment included 445 reviews of confirmed MFs (390 pseudo-mitotic and 55 pseudo-mimicker). Overall, 81.6 % 81.6\% of reviewed MFs ( 363 / 445 363/445 ) fit within a box of at most 50 × 50 50\times 50 pixels. Specifically, 3.1 % 3.1\% of MFs fit within a box of 25 pixels, 78.4 % 78.4\% within 50 pixels, 14.2 % 14.2\% within 75 pixels, and 4.3 % 4.3\% exceeded 75 pixels. The fixed pseudo box therefore provides coarse spatial supervision for token-level learning.

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en: In this work, we proposed MiTHras, a task-specific hierarchical SCL framework for MF analysis. MiTHras builds on ViT-base pretrained on 1.8 million images from 6,041 WSIs. In comparison to the ViT-large UNI-DINOv2 model, pretrained on 100 million images from 100,426 WSIs [ 48 ] , MiTHras achieved higher mean F 1 on the three classification and two subtype benchmarks, despite its smaller backbone and corpus. Furthermore, its second-stage classifier required lower inference time than the larger ViT-large and ViT-huge encoders (Table V ). These results underscore the value of aligning pretraining data and objectives with MF analysis.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了MITHras,一个针对任务分级的SCL框架,用于MF分析. MITHras基于来自6,041个WPIS的180万个图像的ViT-base预训. 相较于从100,426个WPIS[48]中预训出1亿个图像的ViT大型UNI-DINOv2模型,MITHras在三个分类和两个子类型基准上实现了更高的平均F 1,尽管它的骨干和正文. 此外,其第二阶段的分类器需要比较大的ViT大和ViT-huge编码器更低的推断时间(表五)。 这些结果突出了使培训前数据和目标与MF分析相协调的价值。

blocks.en: The tumor-filter comparison (Section V-E ) merits further explanation, given that IMPaSh–trained on labeled colorectal tissue patches–performed comparably to CONCH. We attribute this comparable efficacy to IMPaSh’s capability in distinguishing non-tumor tissues rather than broad organ coverage. IMPaSh assigns each sub-patch to tumor or one of eight non-tumor categories. Aside from normal colon mucosa, the remaining categories (adipose, background, debris, lymphocytes, mucus, smooth muscle, and stroma) exhibit common morphological characteristics across diverse organs. Accordingly, filtering out these components may support tumor patch selection beyond the colorectal domain. CONCH, by comparison, learned broad pathology visual-language representations, without being explicitly optimized for tumor detection. Its broader organ coverage therefore need not translate into higher precision for this particular filtering task. Nevertheless, both filters operate as pre-processing steps to generate the pretraining MF and mimicker cropss. The small difference in eight-evaluation F 1 mean (IMPaSh: 0.769 vs. CONCH: 0.765) indicates limited aggregate sensitivity to this filtering choice.
blocks.zh: 肿瘤过滤器的比较(V-E节)值得进一步解释,因为IMPaSh在贴有标签的直肠组织补丁上受过训练,其效果与CONCH相当。 我们把这种类似的功效归因于IMPaSh区分非肿瘤组织的能力,而不是广泛的器官覆盖。 IMPaSh将每个子patch指定为肿瘤或8个非肿瘤类别之一. 除了正常的结肠黏液外,其余的类别(二联体、背景、碎片、淋巴细胞、黏液、平滑肌肉和血压)在不同的器官中表现出共同的形态特征。 因此,过滤出这些组件可能会支持除去分泌域之外的肿瘤补丁选择. 相比之下,CONCH学习了广义的病理学视觉语言表现,没有为肿瘤检测明确优化. 因此,其更广泛的器官覆盖面不需要转化为这一特定过滤任务的更精确性。 尽管如此,两种滤波器都作为预处理步骤运行,以生成预训练MF和Mimicker作物. 八分评价F 1的相差小(IMPASh: 0.769 vs. CONCH: 0.765)表明对这个过滤选择的总敏感度有限.

blocks.en: MiTHras integrates pseudo-label-guided local alignment with global class alignment and masked reconstruction. Local representation learning methods such as VICRegL [ 52 ] use correspondences between augmented views, whereas MiTHras groups tokens by their mitotic or non-mitotic pseudo-labels. The binary token labels distinguish mitotic from non-mitotic regions–aiding typical-versus-atypical classification–they do not consistently enhance discrimination among eight morphology classes. This may be ascribable to the use of fixed pseudo bounding boxes, providing coarse and imperfect spatial labels.
blocks.zh: MITHras将伪标签制导的局部对接与全球类对接和被蒙面重建整合. 当地代表学习方法,如VICRegL[52]使用增益观点之间的对应,而MITHras群以相模或非相模假标签来表示. 二进制符号标签区分了相形异形和相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 这可能可以归因于使用固定的伪界框,提供粗糙和不完善的空间标签。

blocks.en: The largest performance advantages of MiTHras over competing models emerge under linear probing, whereas detection results were comparable due to the recall constraint of the shared first-stage candidate detector. Moreover, detection performance universally declined on TCGA-MF-Test compared to MIDOGpp (e.g., MiTHras F 1 dropped from 0.829 0.829 to 0.599 0.599 ), likely due to varying slide quality and acquisition conditions. Similar degradation has been reported by Jahanifar et al . [ 18 ] and Aubreville et al . [ 8 ] on multi-domain datasets such as MIDOG21 and MIDOG22. This consistent decline across architectures and pretraining strategies indicates a persistent transfer challenge and motivates broader external validation.
blocks.zh: 在线性探测下,MITHras相对于相竞模型最大的性能优势出现,而由于共享的第一阶段候选探测器的召回限制,检测结果具有可比性。 此外,与MIDOGpp相比,TCGA-MF-Test的探测性能普遍下降(例如,MITHras F 1从0.829 0.829降至0.599 0.599),这可能是由于幻灯片质量和获取条件不同而导致的。 Jahanifar等人[18]和Aubreville等人[8]报告了在MIDOG21和MIDOG22等多领域数据集上的类似退化。 整个架构和预先培训战略的这种持续下降表明转移工作一直面临挑战并促使外部进行更广泛的验证。

blocks.en:
This study has several limitations.
First, the benefits of MiTHras vary across tasks and datasets. Notably, MF subtype classification remains challenging and requires extended validation.
Second, token supervision relies on fixed 50 × 50 50\times 50 pseudo boxes, which may include background or exclude parts of larger MFs, thereby introducing supervision noise. Developing more precise spatial labels represents a promising direction for improving token-level supervision.
Third, the audit identified residual errors in the pseudo labels. 55 of 280 reviewed pseudo-mimicker crops contained true MFs, corresponding to 19.6 % 19.6\% contamination (95% Wilson CI, 15.4 15.4 – 24.7 % 24.7\% ) and a pool-weighted estimate of 21.7 % 21.7\% . Per-cohort estimates ranged from 5 % 5\% to 35 % 35\% , with 20 crops per cohort. These errors can incorrectly group mitotic examples with non-mitotic examples during contrastive learning.
Fourth, although label-interchange experiment demonstrated robustness to pseudo-label noise, this global perturbation may not fully reflect real-world conditions. Label noise can be non-uniform, concentrating on specific organs or challenging morphologies. We leave the development of precise pseudo-label generation and refinement strategies to future investigation.
Fifth, the main survival comparisons use mitotic count as a single morphological predictor. Although an age- and sex-adjusted analysis assesses its incremental contribution, broader CPath survival models can combine morphology, clinical variables, and transcriptomic profiles [ 14 ] . We plan to integrate MiTHras-derived counts into such models to assess their complementary prognostic value.
Finally, the clinical utility of MiTHras has yet to be validated; further studies are needed to assess its impact on real-world diagnostic workflows and outcomes.
blocks.zh:
这项研究有一些局限性。
首先,MITHras的好处因任务和数据集而异. 值得注意的是,MF亚型分类仍然具有挑战性,需要扩大验证范围.
第二,令牌监督依赖于固定的50×5050\的50个伪箱,其中可能包括背景或排除了部分较大的MF,从而引入了监督噪声. 建立更精确的空间标签是改进象征性监督的一个有希望的方向。
三,审计发现假标签中存在剩余错误. 280个经审查的伪米克作物中有55个含有真正的MF,相当于19.6%的19.6%的污染(95%的Wilson CI、15.4 15.4 — 24.7% 24.7 % )和池加权估计的21.7% 21.7 % 。 人均作物估计数在5%-5%-35%-35%-之间,每组有20个作物。 这些错误可以错误地将相差学期间的相差学例与非相差学例组合在一起.
第四,虽然标签-互换实验对伪标签噪声表现出强烈性,但这种全球扰动可能不能充分反映现实世界的条件. 标签噪声可以是非统一性的,集中于特定的器官或具有挑战性的形态. 我们把制定准确的假标签和完善战略留给今后的调查。
第五,主要生存比较使用线粒体计数作为单一形态预测器. 虽然一项年龄和性别调整分析评估了其增量贡献,但更广泛的CPath存活模型可以结合形态学,临床变量,和tellopomic剖面[14]. 我们计划将MITHras衍生的计数纳入这些模型,以评估其互补的预测价值。
最后,MITHras的临床用途尚待验证;需要进一步研究以评估其对现实世界诊断工作流程和结果的影响。

blocks.en: VII Conclusions
blocks.zh: 页:1 结论

blocks.en: MiTHras combines pseudo-label-guided image- and token-level SCL with masked reconstruction for MF analysis. Pretraining on the 1.8-million-image TCGA-MF-Pseudo corpus, it yields strong performance on external benchmarks, outperforming general-purpose and pathology foundation encoders most significantly under linear probing. Token-level supervision improves some subtype results, while its effect varies across tasks and configurations. Future work will explore finer local labels, noise-robust pseudo-labeling, and broader clinical validation to establish the practical utility of MiTHras.
blocks.zh: MITHras结合了伪标签制导的图像-和符号级SCL与蒙面重建用于MF分析. 对180万图象TCGA-MF-Pseudoe的预训,在线性测试下,在外部基准上表现良好,在一般目的和病理基础编码方面表现优异。 托肯级监督可以改善一些子类型的结果,而其效果则因任务和配置而异. 未来的工作将探索更精细的地方标签,噪声-活性假标签,以及更广泛的临床验证,以确立MITHras的实用性.
